title: Block Valley
hook: A block world everyone shares: dig into the hills, light up a cave, build a house by the lake. It all stays.
prompt: a minecraft-like block world for friends: build houses, dig caves, and it keeps what we built

world.notes: The blocky kind's land: biomes, caves with glowcaps and amber crystals, lakes, the hills going on into the haze. One shared world per published game, saved on the play host.

mechanics.as: place, break and paint blocks, lanterns, signs and boom blocks

rules.summary: Build anything with friends. Dig into the hills and caves, light them with lanterns, put up signs, set off a boom block. Everything is saved for everyone.

characters.describe: a block builder in their own colour

accept: you are in the world with whoever is there, and you see each other
a block placed or broken shows for everyone, lit right (a lantern lights a cave)
everything built is still there the next day

content.notes: Building with blocks; a boom block knocks a few out.
